item.title: To the editor: Preparing work force of tomorrow in Toledo
item.description: From energy production to automotive parts, northwest Ohio’s economy depends on a skilled work force and premier learning institutions to prepare and retain the next generation of workers.

item.title: Pakistan is in 'open war' with Afghanistan after latest strikes, defense minister says
item.description: ISLAMABAD — Pakistan and Afghanistan exchanged cross-border attacks overnight in a dramatic escalation of tensions that led Pakistan’s defense minister to say on Friday that the two countries are in a state of “open war.”

item.title: BGSU hockey shuts out Michigan Tech
item.description: HOUGHTON, Mich. — A second-period goal proved to be enough for the Bowling Green men’s hockey team on Friday as the Falcons shut out No.16-ranked Michigan Tech 1-0 in the first game of a two-game, weekend series

item.title: Photo Gallery: 2026 OHSAA Division II state swimming finals
item.description: CANTON — Toledo-area swimmers competed Friday in the Division II swimming state finals at C.T. Branin Natatorium.

item.title: Sorg, Lathrop, Kunsman claim titles at OHSAA Division II state swim meet
item.description: CANTON — Oak Harbor senior Austin Sorg climbed up to a familiar spot atop the podium not once, but twice, in Friday’s OHSAA Division II state swimming tournament.

item.title: Walleye rally with key goal from Waldron, top Bloomington 4-2
item.description: Rookie forward Johnny Waldron was Johnny-on-the-spot for a Walleye team looking for a spark on Friday night.

item.title: Glass City Wranglers fall to Kokomo BobKats in Glass City Center debut
item.description: Despite a home-opening 100-94 defeat to the Kokomo BobKats, Friday marked the start of a new era for the Glass City Wranglers in their fifth season as a team, as they opened play in downtown Toledo at the Glass City Center.

item.title: Pistons outlast short-handed Cavaliers 122-119 in OT after blaring horn delay
item.description: DETROIT — Jalen Duren had 33 points and 16 rebounds and the Detroit Pistons outlasted the short-handed Cleveland Cavaliers 122-119 on Friday night in a game that was delayed for 18 minutes in the third quarter because of a blaring horn.

item.title: High school boys basketball: Toledo Christian, Bowling Green earn 1-point playoff victories
item.description: The Toledo Christian boys basketball team edged Lakota 56-55 in overtime on Friday to advance in the OHSAA Division VI Northwest 3 sectional tournament.

item.title: Owens women's basketball claim Mid-Atlantic District title
item.description: The Owens women’s basketball team rolled to a 117-41 win over Lorain Community College in the NJCAA Division III Mid-Atlantic District championship game on Friday on the campus of Owens Community College.
